info.name: Ava Data Skip Tracing API
info.description:
Skip tracing API from Ava Data, LLC: send a name and address and get phone numbers and emails back in one synchronous call, or upload a CSV of addresses for bulk skip tracing. You pay per match — 1 credit (2¢) per data type per match; a search that finds nothing costs nothing. Every account is on the $9/month plan with 100 credits included.

Setup: set the collection variables `baseUrl` (already https://app.avadata.ai/api/v1) and `apiKey`. Keys are generated from Settings → API Access once an administrator enables API access for your account. Each key is limited to 60 requests per minute.

Built from the public OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec: https://avadata.ai/openapi.json · Docs: https://avadata.ai/docs/ · Pricing: https://avadata.ai/pricing/

request.description:
Flexible search that returns phone data, email data, or both via the dataTypes parameter. Charged 1 credit per data type per match (max 2). Credits are only charged when a match is found.

Required: lastName, dataTypes. dataTypes items: "phone", "email" — ["phone"] = 1 credit, ["email"] = 1 credit, ["phone","email"] = 2 credits.

Response data: matchFound, creditsCharged, phones[] (only when "phone" was requested), emails[] (only when "email" was requested), name, addresses[], matchType.

Comprehensive skip trace returning phone numbers, email addresses, and related persons/family members. Costs 10 credits per match. Credits are only charged when a match is found.

Required: lastName. firstName narrows the search.

Response data: matchFound, creditsCharged (10 when a match is found, otherwise 0), subject (aliases, age, dob, deceased, phones, emails, addresses, bankruptcy) and relatedPeople[] with a relationship on each entry.

item.name: Bulk
item.description: High-volume CSV processing with async jobs.

formdata.description: CSV file (.csv). Must include a header row and at least one data row.
JSON array string of data types to append, e.g. ["phone"], ["email"], or ["phone","email"].

request.description:
Upload a CSV file for high-volume Standard Search processing. The CSV must contain at minimum an 'address' column; firstName, lastName, city, state, and zip columns narrow each search. Credits are reserved upfront and adjusted to actual matches after processing completes (1 credit per data type per match). Returns a jobId to poll for status and download results.

Response data: jobId, lookupId, recordCount, dataTypes[], creditsPerMatch, status, message.

Poll the progress of a bulk processing job.

Response data: jobId, status (uploading | queued | processing | completed | failed), progress (0-100), estimatedSecondsRemaining, numRecords, numMatches, errorMessage.
Download the results of a completed bulk job as JSON (default) or CSV. The job must be in the 'completed' status.

item.name: Digital Matching
item.description: Turn a contact CSV into ready-to-upload Custom Audience files for major ad platforms. Securely hashed identifiers, formatted per platform. Digital Matching prepares the files; it does not launch campaigns.

item.name: Upload CSV to build ad audiences

formdata.description: CSV file (.csv). Must include a header row and at least one data row.
JSON array string of target platforms: "facebook", "google", "linkedin", "tiktok", "generic".

request.description:
Upload a contact CSV and receive ready-to-upload Custom Audience files for the selected ad platforms. The CSV needs an email or phone column, or a name plus address/city/state/zip columns. Credits are reserved upfront and only matched contacts are charged (flat rate per matched contact — every selected platform included).

By uploading you confirm you have the right to use the list for advertising and will follow each ad platform's customer-list policies.

Response data: jobId, lookupId, recordCount, platforms[], creditsPerMatch, status, message.
Poll the progress of a Digital Matching job.

query.description: Optional: facebook | google | linkedin | tiktok | generic. Download a single platform's CSV instead of the full ZIP.

request.description: Download the completed job's audience files. Default is a ZIP containing one ready-to-upload CSV per selected platform, a master data file, and upload instructions. Pass ?platform= to download a single platform's CSV instead. The job must be in the 'completed' status.
